Daily encrypted database backups. One-click restore to any point in the last 30 days.
CPU, memory, disk and transactions per second. Automatic alerts when something is not working as expected.
Each instance gets its own automatic SSL subdomain. Connect your custom domain with a few clicks.
Offer Odoo as a service to your clients. Manage instances, plans and billing from a single panel.
My Odoo plugs into the tools you already use — payments, messaging, AI and automation — no code required.

button.span: Can I migrate my existing Odoo database?

div.p: Yes. Upload your existing database dump during project creation and our platform restores it automatically, keeping your data, users and customizations intact.

button.span: What happens if I exceed my plan's storage or branches?

div.p: We'll notify you before any limit is reached. You can upgrade your plan instantly from the dashboard — there's no downtime or manual migration required.

button.span: Is my data backed up and secure?

div.p: Every instance gets encrypted daily backups with point-in-time restore, isolated databases per client, and automatic SSL on every subdomain and custom domain.

button.span: Can I connect WhatsApp, Stripe or my own AI tools?

div.p: Yes. My Odoo ships with ready-made connections for messaging, payments and automation platforms, plus an AI Assistant integration for smart, no-code workflows.

button.span: Do you offer support during the free trial?

div.p: Absolutely — every trial includes full access to our support team, so you get the same help as a paying customer while you evaluate the platform.
